# Framework behaviourally anchored

`customer_support.df.quality_assurance.framework_behaviourally_anchored` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Behaviourally anchored rating — each mark on each dimension is described by what the agent observably did, never by an adjective.

Adjectival scales (excellent / good / fair) drift per reviewer and per mood, and cannot be calibrated because there is nothing concrete to disagree about. Behavioural anchors make the disagreement locatable and therefore fixable.
